# Token reference

Every token of `@openlinkos/ui` 0.5.0, resolved for light and dark mode with the OpenLinkOS accent. Accent tokens take each brand's colours under `data-brand`; size tokens marked with a density change under `data-density`. The sources are the DTCG files in [`tokens/`](../tokens).

## Colour: surfaces, text and lines

| Token | Light | Dark | Use |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--ol-color-shell` | `#f0f0f3` | `#111113` | The app shell around the floating content panel, and the sidebar. |
| `--ol-color-bg` | `#fcfcfd` | `#111113` | The app background. |
| `--ol-color-bg-subtle` | `#f9f9fb` | `#18191b` | Recessed areas: sidebar, table headings, code. |
